rationale: The Dretsch original abstract identifies a corn-oil ethyl-ester placebo. A later review reports an inconclusive Epworth contrast with a different sample count. The original arm values, analysis sample and time point remain unverified. No isolated refined oil effect is established.

The exact author abstract and publisher PDF locator are verified. The original pain-domain table and oil processing grade remain open. NCT06944392 lists a cold-pressed preparation and has no posted outcomes.

Original endometriosis pain tables favor the flax-labeled arm. The intervention is described as oil, hydroalcoholic extract and seed capsules across the trial and registry. Cold pressing is unverified. The independent arthritis signal retains its minimal easing tier.

The Bian original is still available at abstract depth. Voucher and raw-versus-fried outcome tables remain open. The completed NCT07562672 topical postoperative mixture has no posted registry results or isolated oral comparison.
